get.summary: Active shops, optionally filtered by name.

get.summary: Database reachability and migration status for operators.
Active categories (two levels; children reference ParentId).
Search purchasable listings: text, category (incl. sub-categories), shop, price range, stock; sorted and paged.
Product detail (active products of active shops only).

post.summary: Owner sends a rejected application back to review (Rejected → PendingApproval).
Inactive → Active (owner).
Active → Inactive (owner): hidden, no new orders.

put.summary: Requires `version` (409 if the product changed since it was read).

post.summary: Withdraws the product; it can no longer be bought.
Paid → Accepted.
Accepted → Preparing.
Preparing → ReadyForDelivery.
ReadyForDelivery → Delivered (until courier integration exists).
Paid → Rejected; stock is released and a refund becomes due.

get.summary: Shops with owner email and active product count; filter by status and name.

post.summary: Declines a pending application (reason shown to the owner).

put.summary: Shop-specific commission in basis points; null restores the platform default. Applies to new orders only.

get.summary: Cart priced from current data, grouped by shop (one order per shop at checkout).

put.summary: Adds the product or sets its quantity (1–20). Prices are never accepted from the client.

get.summary: 404 also for orders of other customers.

post.summary: Allowed until the shop accepts the order; stock is released.
Manual payment confirmation (e.g. bank transfer): PendingPayment → Paid. Audited. Not a payment-provider integration.
Cancels any non-terminal order; stock released; refund due recorded if paid. Audited.

get.summary: Counts and money figures for the dashboard.
